import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. Autocomplete is an alias of the same component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Combobox accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except onChange, value, defaultValue, size and children. They are applied to the text input; className goes to the control and wrapperClassName to the root.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The input uses role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant pointing at the active option.
a11y.listbox: The list uses role="listbox" (with aria-multiselectable in multiple mode) and each row role="option" with aria-selected.
a11y.keyboard: Arrow keys move, Enter picks and Escape closes the list.
a11y.label: Without a visible label, pass aria-label. helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.field: Wraps the control and the dropdown menu.

rules.optionActive: Option highlighted by keyboard or mouse.
rules.empty: Message when there are no results.

rules.open: Applied while the list is open.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes except `onChange`, value, `defaultValue`, size and children.

items.options: Menu options. Objects of any shape are supported.
items.value: Controlled value. string[] when multiple is set.
items.onInputChange: Fires on every keystroke. Useful for async option fetching.
items.multiple: Allows more than one selected option.
items.allowsCustomValue: Commits typed text that does not match an option.
items.filter: Client-side filter. Pass false when options are already filtered.
items.openOnFocus: Opens the list when the input is focused.
items.minQueryLength: Minimum characters before filtering or opening.
items.children: Render prop for each row. Receives the original item and its state.
items.renderOption: Same as `children`. `children` wins when both are set.
items.optionValue: Field or getter for each option value.
items.optionLabel: Field or getter for the visible label.
items.optionDisabled: Field or getter that disables an option.
items.optionDescription: Field or getter for the secondary text.
items.optionSearchText: Field or getter used by the filter.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.placeholder: Text shown when the input is empty.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.noResultsText: Copy when the filter matches no options.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.clearable: Shows a control to clear the selection or query.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button. Defaults to "Clear".
items.showExpand: Shows the chevron that opens and closes the list.
items.suffixIcon: Icon at the start of the field. null hides it.
items.isLoading: Shows a spinner. The list stays available.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.name: Native name for hidden form inputs.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onClear: Fires after the value is cleared with the button.
